Hymn 338: America the Beautiful
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Samuel A. Ward
Lyricist/Text Author: Katharine Lee Bates

This is hymn number 338 titled "America the Beautiful" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Samuel A. Ward and the lyrics were written by Katharine Lee Bates.
